cases.title: Deployment Gate

input.request: Prepare a service change for production deployment.

cases.expected_output: Build, migration, monitoring, owner, and rollback checks are evidenced before release approval.
automated_checks: release checklist has evidence per criterion
human_review_rubric: approval is scoped to this deployment
success_criteria: Required outcome: Build, migration, monitoring, owner, and rollback checks are evidenced before release approval.
Verification requirement: release checklist has evidence per criterion
Verification requirement: required checks return expected exit

cases.title: Rollback

input.request: Plan recovery for a failed release.

cases.expected_output: Rollback/forward-fix decision, triggers, owner, data compatibility, and verification are explicit.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Rollback/forward-fix decision, triggers, owner, data compatibility, and verification are explicit.
Verification requirement: rollback rehearsal artifact exists
Verification requirement: post-rollback smoke check passes

cases.title: Ownership

input.request: Prepare on-call handoff for a new service.

cases.expected_output: Service owner, SLO, runbook, paging route, and known failure modes are documented.
automated_checks: required owner and runbook fields present
success_criteria: Required outcome: Service owner, SLO, runbook, paging route, and known failure modes are documented.
Verification requirement: required owner and runbook fields present
